decision.reason: Neither model accepted both complete drafts AND detected every deliberate omission with valid evidence in both repetitions.

evidence: Both models cite the remaining regression-test criterion as coverage for the removed error contract. That text mentions invalid-input/no-write tests but does not specify exit 2, JSON stderr, ID range or database isolation.
GPT-4.1 correctly identifies the missing regression-test criterion in both repetitions.
One mini review contains an invalid architecture quotation; the validator blocks it, but that does not count as detecting the removed state-preservation rule.
Every complete draft passes citation validation and review.

conclusion: Exact references improve auditability and catch invalid citations, but do not prove the cited passage entails every clause. Both models still falsely accept incomplete requirements in this bounded sample. Do not promote this experiment to an automatic acceptance gate.
next_recommendation: Keep human requirements approval and independent acceptance checks. Before another full run, create an explicit atomic acceptance checklist from the original task, retaining exact values and constraints as the source of truth. Evaluate one-requirement-at-a-time coverage against controlled omissions instead of relying on broad paragraph-level coverage or changing models alone.
